author: Cindy Hartshorn
text: Bob Meigs the cgm is a tool to help you understand your glucose levels on a daily basis. The margin of error is +/- 20%. An A1c test is another tool looking at the longer picture ( about 3 months). All of the tools AND how you feel, what you’ve eaten, etc. all factor into your diabetes and control of it.  Your glucose ( whether diabetic or not) is in constant fluctuation and a reading from any source will most likely not be the exact same.  You should discuss your concerns with your doctor and decide if using a cgm is the right choice for you since you have doubts about its accuracy.  For me it’s about seeing trends and not so much the actual number. I hope you are able to get a better understanding and gain confidence in your cgm.
